## Reproduction

Include commit SHA, operating system, Python/AppWorld versions, exact command, configuration hash, run ID, and redacted logs.

## Evidence safety

Do not paste credentials, private endpoints, protected AppWorld data, database snapshots, or unredacted logs.

## Scientific impact

State whether the defect affects implementation only, evidence integrity, an evaluator/gate, or a scientific claim.
